Ready to go? Work at the biggest HUB from DPD world wide. 🌍 Millions of packages are delivered here daily. And you are responsible for ensuring those packages arrive at the correct dock. 📦 Working in evening and nights and earn some salary from €14,76 untill €19,00 euros per hour in the night. 💰

What we offer
- Salary up to €19,90 in night
- Friendly atmosphere with enthusiastic colleagues
- Shift allowances up to 45%
- Opportunities for personal growth and development
- Possibilities for a permanent contract with DPD
- working at the largest HUB in the world from DPD

Who you are
- Driving license C or T
- Good command of English, both spoken and written
- Reliable, responsible, and flexible with working hours. Your shifts will be from 13:00h until 22:00h and from 21:30 until 06:00h.

What will you do
You are responsible for the safe and timely transport of parcels within the depot. You do this by arranging and moving loads one by one, ensuring the sorting process runs smoothly and parcels can be delivered on time.
You will work in shifts with the following hours:
Day shift: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM
Night shift: 9:30 PM – 6:00 AM

You start Sunday night and work through until Friday morning in the morning shift.

- Carefully load, unload, and arrange parcels according to schedule
- Communicate with colleagues and logistics staff, mainly in English
- Contribute to a smooth logistics process so that over 100,000 parcels can be processed and shipped daily

Where will you work
DPD processes over 100,000 parcels daily at our depots, where they are received, sorted, and prepared for distribution. As a shuttle driver, you play an important role in this. You ensure that parcels are moved quickly and efficiently between the different sorting and loading points within the Best depot.
